content_sections.heading: APPSC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has officially released six brief notifications dated 15 September 2026 for direct recruitment to Inspector of Factories, English Reporters, Telugu Reporters, Assistant Statistical Officer, Analyst Grade-II and Assistant Director posts. A total of 255 provisional vacancies have been announced across these posts. The notifications include details on post-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, pay scales, important dates, selection process and online application procedure. Candidates are strongly advised to read the Detailed Notification carefully before applying. The notifications are available on the official APPSC website. Download APPSC Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Direct Link to Apply Official Website

content_sections.heading: APPSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Each post under APPSC Recruitment 2026 has its own educational qualification requirement. Candidates must possess the required qualification as on the date of the Detailed Notification. Full eligibility, including age limit and community-wise relaxation, will be published in the Detailed Notification. A Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Industrial Engineering from a recognised university, along with a minimum of two years of industrial work experience in medium and large-scale manufacturing process industries, preferably in Industrial Safety, Occupational Safety, Health and Environment Management. The experience certificate must be issued by the Chief Executive of the concerned industry. For English Reporters: a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline, Shorthand (English) at a minimum speed of 150 words per minute, and Typewriting (English) of a higher grade from the State Board of Technical Education. For Telugu Reporters: a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline, Shorthand and Typewriting (Telugu) both of a higher grade, and a practical test at 80 words per minute in Telugu Shorthand. Preference is given to candidates who additionally hold the corresponding qualification in the other language. A Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as a main subject, or with Mathematics, Economics, Commerce, or Computer Science as a main subject provided Statistics was studied as a paper in one, two, or all three years of the degree. A Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Bio-Chemistry, Biology or Environmental Sciences from a recognised university. First Class candidates will be given preference. A first or second class Master's Degree in Social Anthropology, Sociology or Social Work from a recognised university, along with a minimum of two publications in national-level academic journals. A Postgraduate Degree in Mathematics, Pure Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Applied Economics, Applied Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Econometrics or Computer Science from a recognised university.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: For every post under APPSC Recruitment 2026, selection is through a single-level examination only; no Screening Test will be conducted irrespective of the number of applications received. The examination will be conducted in online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. If the single-level exam is held across multiple sessions, APPSC will apply a normalisation process to the marks, with the methodology to be notified separately. For all objective-type papers, each wrong answer is penalised with one-third of the marks prescribed for that question, as per the applicable government orders cited in each notification's syllabus annexure.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APPSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only in online mode through the official APPSC website. Applications sent through any other mode will not be accepted under any circumstances. Visit the official APPSC website at psc.ap.gov.in . Locate the Online Application link for the relevant notification number (09/2026, 10/2026, 14/2026, 20/2026, 21/2026 or 22/2026). Read the Detailed Notification and instructions carefully before filling the form. Fill in the Online Application Form with accurate personal, educational and other required details. Submit the application well before the last date, 2 November 2026, to avoid last-minute rush.

faq.question: Q1. What is APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: APPSC Recruitment 2026 refers to six brief notifications (No. 09/2026, 10/2026, 14/2026, 20/2026, 21/2026 and 22/2026) issued by the Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission on 15 September 2026 for direct recruitment to Inspector of Factories, English/Telugu Reporters, Assistant Statistical Officer, Analyst Grade-II, and two Assistant Director posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 255 provisional vacancies are notified across the six posts, subject to variation upon confirmation from the concerned departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 2 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification differs by post, ranging from a relevant Bachelor's Degree (Inspector of Factories, Reporters, Assistant Statistical Officer, Analyst Grade-II) to a Postgraduate Degree (Assistant Director posts). See the Eligibility Criteria section above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not specified in the brief notification. It will be announced with the Detailed Notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the brief notification. It will be announced with the Detailed Notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for APPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online only, through the official website psc.ap.gov.in, between 13 October 2026 and 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for APPSC Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Pay scales range from Rs. 37,640–1,15,500 (Assistant Statistical Officer) to Rs. 65,360–1,54,980 (Inspector of Factories). See the Salary section above for the pay scale of each post.
